description: This file defines the interface for handling reverse index structures within Git pack files, including functions for loading, verifying, and converting between different object position representations within packs and multi-pack indexes.

methods.name: load_pack_revindex
methods.description: Loads and initializes a reverse index for a specified pack, populating internal data structures, with success indicated by returning zero.

methods.name: load_pack_revindex_from_disk
methods.description: Loads a pack's reverse index directly from its .rev file on disk.

methods.name: verify_pack_revindex
methods.description: Checks whether the on-disk reverse index matches a freshly created index, returning a negative number if an error occurs.

methods.name: load_midx_revindex
methods.description: Loads the reverse index for a multi-pack index from its .rev file, returning negative on error or positive if no reverse index exists.

methods.name: close_midx_revindex
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a multi-pack reverse index.

methods.name: offset_to_pack_pos
methods.description: Converts an object byte offset to a pack-relative position, loading the reverse index lazily if necessary.

methods.name: pack_pos_to_index
methods.description: Converts a pack-relative position to an index-relative position, aborting on errors or out-of-bounds.

methods.name: pack_pos_to_offset
methods.description: Converts a pack-relative position to a byte offset within the pack, supporting on-disk and in-memory formats.

methods.name: pack_pos_to_midx
methods.description: Converts a pack-relative position to a MIDX position.

methods.name: midx_to_pack_pos
methods.description: Converts a MIDX-relative position to a pack position, with bounds checking.

methods.name: midx_pair_to_pack_pos
methods.description: Converts a pack ID and offset pair within a MIDX to a pack position.
